risk_description: Eligibility rules may be too complex for users to understand without assisted support
Document requirements may exclude people with limited records or low time capacity
Lack of meaningful status may create anxiety repeat contact and mistrust
Support escalation may fail when ownership and case context are unclear
Digital form may exclude users with disability language device or connectivity barriers
Decision notices may be legally correct but hard to understand or challenge
Service records and renewal logic may drift without ownership and quality monitoring
Renewal may force users to resubmit information already known to the service
